column1: #  - record and enum (including ones nested in a record body) are class; interface is interface; `type X = ...` (also inside a record body) is type_alias;

#  - function f, local function f, global function f (at any depth) and `local f = function` / `global f = function` are function; function M.f and function M.A.f are function named f; function M:m is method named m;

#  - a top-level `local NAME <const>` (or <total>) whose value is a literal, an operator expression, a table constructor or a call other than require() is constant; aliases of other modules' members and require() imports are not;
#  - a top-level local or global initialised with a table constructor is variable;
#  - record fields, enum values, plain locals, forward declarations (`global x: T`) and function-valued fields are not definitions.
